name: Teen Volunteers at Scottsdale Public Library
what_you_do: Help at the library and earn documented volunteer hours. Some teens are Reading Buddies who work closely with school-age children over the summer.
who_can_apply: Teens must be at least 14 and not yet 18. A parent or guardian must give permission.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You earn documented volunteer hours.
duration: School year program runs September to May. Summer program runs June to July.
deadline_text: School year: fill out the interest form on the program page. Summer applications are open April 1 to 30 (Civic Center and Mustang libraries only). Summer 2026 applications have ended.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form on the program page. A teen volunteer coordinator will contact you. New summer volunteers must go to a required orientation.
notes: Space is limited, and applying does not guarantee a spot. The program page says the Mustang and Arabian school year programs are full. New summer volunteers must attend a general orientation.
